bagPolicy.summary: Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: General admission parking is included with your ticket. For easier entry and exit, consider upgrading to Premier Parking or VIP Parking.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Guests can also enjoy Koko's Bavarian sausages and pretzels, as well as CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream. Concessions include classic concert bites like popcorn and nachos, along with a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-Entry is not permitted at Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will call tickets are available for pickup at the box office located (Insert Location Information). Guests are not permitted to put tickets in will call for other guests to pick up.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
